steps.summary: Declare an ELISA plate and select standard, unknown, blank, and control wells with plate selectors.
Add capture antibody to assay wells under high_precision and low_carryover requirements, then incubate overnight.
Wash wells by adding wash buffer, agitating, separating aspirated wash liquid from retained assay state, and routing filtrate to waste.
Add blocking buffer under high_precision and low_carryover requirements, incubate, and wash.
Load standard curve wells, unknown sample wells, positive and negative controls, and blank wells under registered precision/carryover constraints.
Add detection antibody under high_precision and low_carryover requirements, incubate, and wash.
Add enzyme conjugate under high_precision and low_carryover requirements, incubate, and wash.
Add substrate under high_precision, low_carryover, and dark_protected requirements, incubate under dark_protected, and stop reaction.
Read absorbance and record simple blank, positive-control, and negative-control QC flags through data_schema, data_ref.result fields, and if branches.
